purpose: End-to-end real Cochrane strategy combining MeSH, historical aliasing, free text, truncation, RCT filters, animal exclusion and line references.
authority: Normative Cochrane Ovid MEDLINE-to-PubMed Conversion Rules v20
mesh_stub_note: Fixture-only deterministic MeSH metadata. IDs/URIs are deliberately synthetic and must not be treated as production NLM data.
source_note: Real Ovid MEDLINE strategy content from Cochrane review CD003594 (Interventions for idiopathic steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome in children), 20 preserved numbered lines. The RTF container in this fixture is reconstructed for deterministic testing rather than copied as the original Word RTF binary.
